notice:
Descriptive candidate review, not binding, affinity, efficacy, selection or synthesis readiness. One selected sample; no pooled subjects or inferred independent replicates. Size counts assigned observations (sample-scoped cells or bulk heavy-chain rows), not reads or molecules. Mutation pools observed heavy-row differences/evaluable V/J bases, not historical events or mutation rates; incomplete rows make ranking unavailable. Preferred-class share requires every assigned observation's class to be resolved. Share change is current minus explicitly named baseline observation share, not a statistical expansion test; zero observed counts do not establish biological absence. All metrics condition on the saved family definition, QC and reference choices. Missing values sort last in either direction; exact rational ties retain the same competition rank.

Dataset: Simulated B-cell study · supplied chain evidence (d-d72a3e62b9050380), 6 samples, abundance in cells.

Clonotypes: Length-normalized nucleotide Hamming distance on paired heavy/light junctions, using the larger of the two normalized distances; identical V and J genes and junction length on each compared chain, within subject. Productive ACGT junctions and resolved genes only; ambiguous/missing evidence is excluded. Each distinct receptor contributes once to nearest distances; no comparable receptor is missing, not zero. Single-linkage families at distance ≤ 0.1; chains of links can join receptors farther apart than the threshold. Threshold-dependent families are not proven ancestry or the existing junction clonotypes. (ClonoLoom definition ).
Method: Descriptive ordered criteria (ClonoLoom policy); AIRR Rearrangement 2.0. Family, reference, mutation and isotype methods/citations are retained in the parent manifests. No calibrated binding or efficacy model..

limits: One unchanged supplied AIRR sequence_aa chain, not a complete receptor or synthesis-ready construct. complete_vdj describes the annotated V(D)J region, not full-protein completeness. No translation, repair, consensus, chain assembly, codon optimization or inferred ancestor. A cell-associated heavy/light assignment is the saved family's operational definition, not independent validation of biological pairing. FASTA uses an opaque safe identifier; original identities and annotations remain in the companion evidence. Proteoscope review requires fresh local/public/provider permissions and sends nothing on opening. This review is separate from project artifacts and scientific replay.
